config.balanced_subset: six demo orders; alternating mapping; both query-sign twins
config.carrier: A routine maintenance record is open. Hidden state marker: §
config.estimand: layerwise necessity for demonstration-mediated hidden-state reporting
config.patch: all query-head contexts from the paired test_only donor before o_proj

analysis_rules.baseline_gate: target-test_only conditional-correct-probability gap >= 0.15 and accuracy gap >= 0.25
analysis_rules.candidate_gate: a syntax-specific role removes >= 20% of the aggregate baseline margin, retains format rate >= 0.90, and retains mean label mass >= 80% of target
analysis_rules.inference: no p-values or population intervals from this single-family screen
analysis_rules.overlap: receiver-role effects overlap and are not additive
analysis_rules.primary: signed correct-minus-wrong Q/K margin; report conditional correct probability, accuracy, format, label mass, and target-to-patch KL
analysis_rules.removal_fraction: ratio of aggregate paired mean margin drops: mean(target-patch)/mean(target-test_only); never average rowwise ratios
analysis_rules.selection: carry at most the top two layers per syntax-specific role to a separately frozen multi-concept/head screen; all_positions is diagnostic only
analysis_rules.stop: stop this route grammar if the baseline gate fails, no syntax-specific role passes, or only the all_positions envelope passes; do not inspect individual heads under this protocol
analysis_rules.unit: 12 exact nuisance cells for one concept/carrier family; descriptive development screening only

protocol.claim_boundary: A positive result is layer/receiver-role sensitivity under a paired hybrid interchange, not QK-only mediation, natural indirect effect, semantic introspection, safety-monitor robustness, or a readable program. A null does not exclude distributed, redundant, residual, MLP-carried, or compensatory routes.

design.carrier: A routine maintenance record is open. Hidden state marker: §
design.cells: all six balanced demonstration orders; mapping alternates by order; both query-sign twins (12 cells)
design.interchange: replace all 16 pre-o_proj query-head contexts at one layer/receiver role with the exact paired test_only context

instrumentation_gates.artifact_binding: save prompt, token, direction, donor, recipient, and logit hashes
instrumentation_gates.model_loading: pinned revision from the project-local cache in offline mode
instrumentation_gates.pre_injection_sentinels: target and test_only must be bit-identical
instrumentation_gates.recipient_binding: each patched pre-o_proj input must equal its cached target
instrumentation_gates.self_donor: all-layer/all-position target self-patch max full-logit error <= 1e-06

protocol.previous_attempt_disclosure: Protocol v1 was frozen, then its first smoke launch failed before model loading because the project-local Hugging Face cache was not selected and network access was unavailable. No model output or result artifact existed. V2 changes only offline cache selection and records that execution mode.
protocol.safety_goal: Test whether demonstration-mediated hidden-state reporting has a small, causally auditable downstream attention route before attempting a shortcut-resistant programmatic reporter.
protocol.smoke_disclosure: Before the full screen, one query-twin pair and layer 10 may be inspected only for instrumentation. Any source/design change requires a new protocol; smoke outcomes may not select layers or alter gates.
